### Specify caller-visible behavior for five Java collection changes

[`e822c6541dbc`](https://github.com/pilifs/in-the-loop/commit/e822c6541dbc991ca023e1e6978b1bff3786a694) · [log `89db695f6dd3`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/01a2134f-183c-7b32-9ab7-7cb44b04d209/89db695f6dd3de207eda2faa09e1bd21d1e75084703bca4e3f8942893046e603.jsonl.gz)

Add cases on exception-safe map updates, unique indexes, null remapping, primitive array copies and extreme rotations. Check 15 claims against pinned source and regression evidence. The changed-file selector found no applicable tests.

### Specify arithmetic and graph behavior across signed and sparse inputs

[`facbf8a85250`](https://github.com/pilifs/in-the-loop/commit/facbf8a8525071b23e69317b8fb7d3cf43b31ec0) · [log `89db695f6dd3`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/01a2134f-183c-7b32-9ab7-7cb44b04d209/89db695f6dd3de207eda2faa09e1bd21d1e75084703bca4e3f8942893046e603.jsonl.gz)

Add claims for fraction division, coordinate cloning, connectivity notifications, undirected cycles and negative tour weights. Check both graph components and reconstruct a tour weight from the public path. The ten-case handoff check passed.

### Specify Java reader, stream and Base58 boundary behavior

[`fd790ecec05c`](https://github.com/pilifs/in-the-loop/commit/fd790ecec05cb9460cb48f221557c595ace43e71) · [log `da021f7ce3be`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/01a2134f-183c-7b32-9ab7-7cb44b04d209/da021f7ce3be7d6afe3f6d70fa0292653b47ba3a65245c96c70aba9c68332167.jsonl.gz)

Add claims on filtered reads, bounded skips, zero-length file reads, overwriting bytes and custom alphabets. Compare the read-ahead promise with the actual skip code and check mapped output against independent readers.

### Specify archive, Unicode, geometry and CSV readback

[`e9bf9d83a8fd`](https://github.com/pilifs/in-the-loop/commit/e9bf9d83a8fd1f037f510018e18b005c6ce5397b) · [log `672b08a4dc1c`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/01a2134f-183c-7b32-9ab7-7cb44b04d209/672b08a4dc1c09e106ba36c43a20aca78eeb56d5d8c59b4eb7388aed86f83346.jsonl.gz)

Add checks for CPIO destination offsets, TAR sparse alignment, UTF-32 refill boundaries, XYM geometry and empty leading CSV fields. Derive the CPIO checksum and geometry length and record the MongoDB format documentation caveat.

### Specify generated source and reflective record behavior

[`3cd8d23f6876`](https://github.com/pilifs/in-the-loop/commit/3cd8d23f68767142c5fb50a8d929ea4b78fe0b99) · [log `d0a59a035a98`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/01a2134f-183c-7b32-9ab7-7cb44b04d209/d0a59a035a980d1710aecc005e5a12e923b85ae3b6ef5562e800380d2475c61d.jsonl.gz)

Add cases on JavaPoet long literals and annotated boxing, JavaParser lexical preservation, and nested Moshi record bindings. Check the two-commit printer range and the enclosing type needed by the Moshi regression.

### Specify JSON number, builder, map and XML name behavior

[`e3d81d338b66`](https://github.com/pilifs/in-the-loop/commit/e3d81d338b664a66f49929007a1f890926033c4d) · [log `5d87b62781cd`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/01a2134f-183c-7b32-9ab7-7cb44b04d209/5d87b62781cd081cf6fdef3f0eaa987610aabb4d535dfcdc3e1c564269f4153e.jsonl.gz)

Add cases on integral wrapper types, numeric parser state, immutable builder assignments, EnumMap merging and reversible encoded XML names. Compare accessor sequences, serialized values and independent XML consumption against pinned fixtures.

### Specify database array, planner cast and Arrow holder behavior

[`94e4790cbfec`](https://github.com/pilifs/in-the-loop/commit/94e4790cbfec96c1cada104e1c7430e7206e2298) · [log `552290d5e9c5`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/01a2134f-183c-7b32-9ab7-7cb44b04d209/552290d5e9c5381fd16ffce35ee59b521902d81020d2fb57ef7e297bb66f0b1c.jsonl.gz)

Add typed JDBC array readback, nested Java aliases, nested SQL casts, sub-millisecond planner literals and signed Arrow holder reads. Check the H2 issue controls and the Calcite type-system precision override.

### Specify decimal, duration, column path and offset date results

[`82c91bcdcc70`](https://github.com/pilifs/in-the-loop/commit/82c91bcdcc70dfbfbeb27a3e1ab683b0b3bb675a) · [log `7d0cf71ab853`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/01a2134f-183c-7b32-9ab7-7cb44b04d209/7d0cf71ab85324525b63ee48343df6482636359ed95fe716ac3d2ffd99eec45d.jsonl.gz)

### Specify reactive cancellation, error delivery and retry behavior

[`1e4eb8884292`](https://github.com/pilifs/in-the-loop/commit/1e4eb8884292ba4742ea01b1c01d218e55b3d861) · [log `ffb1b19e7e53`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/01a2134f-183c-7b32-9ab7-7cb44b04d209/ffb1b19e7e5386d6b776f57a1e1d26edd3b3d4ac0aab858f4a600b30734b465b.jsonl.gz)

Add five cases on RxJava concatenation cancellation and group delivery, Reactor delayed errors and thenMany, and negative retry intervals. Check source subscriptions, terminal signals and independent retry event observations.

### Complete the organic Java R01–R50 verification brief
